# AllRosters

> AllRosters is a free, read-only live scoreboard for people who play in more than one Sleeper fantasy football league. It shows every Sleeper NFL league for a username on one screen, with live scores, win probability, and the points left on the bench.

AllRosters is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Sleeper or the NFL. It works with Sleeper leagues only (not ESPN, Yahoo or NFL.com). It needs only a public Sleeper username: no account, login or password. It cannot change lineups, trades or waivers.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://allrosters.com/): what AllRosters does, how to set it up, how win probability is calculated, and FAQ
- [Scoreboard](https://allrosters.com/scoreboard): the app itself, which runs in the browser
- [Privacy](https://allrosters.com/privacy): what is stored, what is sent to Sleeper, and the analytics used

## Key facts

- Price: free, no ads, no account
- Platform: any web browser; can be added to a phone home screen
- Data: Sleeper's public API (rosters, matchups, projections, stats) and Sleeper's live NFL scores
- Refresh: every 45 seconds by default; 30 seconds, 90 seconds or 5 minutes are options
- Win probability: points scored plus each remaining starter's projection scaled by the share of their game left; per-player uncertainty is combined and the probability that the projected margin ends above zero is read from a normal distribution; players listed Out, Doubtful, IR or suspended count for nothing
- Views: every league side by side on the home screen, each league in its own color and letter; per league, a lineup view, a head-to-head matchup view (both lineups slot by slot), a league view of every matchup that week with scores, win odds and projections (each opens slot by slot), live NFL game clocks, and standings
- Multi-league players: a player on the visitor's roster in more than one league carries a solid letter tag for each other league; an outlined tag marks a league where that player starts against the visitor
- Many leagues: up to four leagues show as cards; more than four show as compact rows with a count of leagues up, down and tied. Each league gets one of eight colors and a unique one- or two-character code. Settings can hide leagues, which are then not loaded
- Home screen: starters currently in live games, or between games the next kickoffs involving the visitor's starters
- Left on the bench: the difference between points scored and the best legal lineup from the full roster, respecting flex eligibility, with the swaps that would have closed the gap
- Scoring: point breakdowns use each league's own scoring settings (PPR, half-PPR, standard and custom)
- Privacy: no accounts; the username and preferences are stored only in the visitor's browser, which is how returning visitors see their leagues; https://allrosters.com/scoreboard?user=USERNAME opens a given user's leagues on any device. Anonymous Google Analytics 4 measures pages and feature use without usernames; it is off by default in the EEA, UK and Switzerland, honors Global Privacy Control, and can be turned off in settings. Details: https://allrosters.com/privacy
